text:
kevin: heads up — planning to enable hydra-10b-v2 in the catalog during next change window (thu 02:00 UTC). want to align pinlist and fallback ordering before deploy.
maria: +1. what's the canary plan? how many requests will hit it initially?
aj: recommend 2% global canary, drain after 20m if no regressions. we should also pin dedicated customers to hydra-10b-v1 for 24h by default.
lina: can we route EU traffic to the new model first? smaller impact region and easier rollback.
kevin: yes — canary routing: 2% eu, 0.5% us, rest to current default. fallback priority: hydra-10b-v1 -> harbor-13b-quant -> legacy-llama-7b.
sam: please add short release notes for the marketing / docs team. include known regressions and perf deltas.
kevin: draft release notes: "hydra-10b-v2: improved answer grounding, ~12% token cost reduction in quant mode, slightly higher memory spikes observed in 1% of long context runs". will post in #release-notes once approved.
aj: put an automatic rollback trigger: if p99 gen latency increases >150ms vs baseline or error rate >0.8% during canary, rollback immediately.
telemetry-bot: perf baseline snapshot created: run_id=2026-03-21-hydra-cand; streaming link: https://telemetry.internal/runs/2026-03-21-hydra-cand
deploybot: scheduled enable: command `deploybot enable-model --name hydra-10b-v2 --canary 2% --regions eu,us --start 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z` — queued by kevin. :gear:
maria: add a pin for dedicated customers: `catalog pin --model hydra-10b-v1 --scope dedicated --ttl 24h` — ops needs this before canary.
lina: observability checklist: heatmaps for seq len distribution, KV cache hit rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, token cost breakdown. aj pls confirm dashboards.
aj: confirm — dashboards in ops/board#hydra-canary. alerts: latency-surge, error-rate, memory-spike; paging to eng-oncall.
kevin: plan for rollback communication: if rollback happens, we post: "Rollback: hydra-10b-v2 disabled; traffic reverted to hydra-10b-v1; root cause investigation in #eng-runtime." assign oncall to lead investigation.
sam: can we include a short snippet in release notes about fallback ordering? helps product folks understand behavior.
kevin: good call — adding: "Fallback ladder: hydra-10b-v1 -> harbor-13b-quant -> legacy-llama-7b. automatic fallback on model error or latency SLO breach. Manual pin overrides allowed via catalog pin command."
maria: last check — are all canary tests green? stress + safety evaluations?
kevin: running final safety evals now, should be done in ~30m. will update this thread when deploybot moves to starting state.
telemetry-bot: safety evals completed: toxicity/response-coherence basic checks passed. report: https://telemetry.internal/reports/hydra-safety-2026-03-21
deploybot: status update — queued job id=987654321 start=2026-03-25T02:00:00Z. will post again at start and when canary complete.
aj: I'll prepare rollback playbook and a short runbook snippet for oncall.
kevin: thanks — if anyone else wants to sign off, react with :thumbsup:. otherwise I'll proceed to kick off on schedule.
lina: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
aj: :thumbsup:
